applicationFee.note: Applications with international credentials $90; otherwise $55. Graduate Admissions offers waivers based on documented financial need. No citizenship limitation is stated on this graduate policy; confirm international eligibility and approval before payment.

english.toefl: 78 if taken on/before January21,2026; 4 if taken after that date
english.note: IELTS Academic, every module at least6.0. PTE52 or TOEFL Essentials8.5 also accepted. Bachelor’s or higher from an accredited US institution or equivalent from a listed exempt country exempts testing. Program does not admit applicants below its scores.

documents: Transcripts from each institution where credit granted
Statement of purpose describing professional aspirations and doctoral goals
Intent-to-mentor letter emailed directly by current doctoral faculty member
requirements.note: Master’s route: related natural-science master’s and graduate GPA3.25. Bachelor’s-only route: related degree, GPA3.5 overall or in the last 60 undergraduate hours, including any completed graduate courses in the GPA assessment; other disciplines case by case. Secure faculty agreement before applying; mentor letter must arrive by deadline. The wording does not require bachelor’s-only applicants to have taken graduate courses.

funding.note: Instructional/teaching assistantships are competitive for qualified full-time doctoral students. Scholarships also available. No universal funding or current stipend established.
